name: Introduction to Java
description: How Java source becomes a running program (JDK, compiler, bytecode, JVM); writing a class with a main method and printing output

name: Variables and Data Types
description: Declaring, initialising and reassigning variables; the common types int, long, double, char, boolean and String

name: Operators and Expressions
description: Arithmetic, comparison and logical operators; integer division, remainder, precedence and how expressions evaluate

name: Conditionals
description: Branching with if, else-if and else; ordering conditions and matching each else to its if

name: Loops
description: Repeating work with while, for and do-while; counting, accumulator and sentinel patterns; break, continue and off-by-one errors

name: Nested Loops
description: Loops inside loops and how the total number of iterations multiplies; tables, patterns and pairs

name: Methods
description: Defining and calling static methods; parameters versus arguments, return values, void, pass-by-value and overloading

name: Method Call Flow and Scope
description: Methods calling other methods and the order calls start and finish; each call's own local variables; variable scope and shadowing

name: Arrays
description: Declaring and creating arrays; zero-based indexing, length and default values

name: Iterating over Arrays
description: Traversing arrays with indexed and enhanced for loops; sum, maximum, counting, linear search, reversing and copying

name: Classes and Objects
description: Classes versus objects; fields, constructors and instance methods; creating objects with new

name: References
description: Primitive versus reference variables; aliasing, mutating shared objects and arrays, null and NullPointerException

name: Tracing Program Execution
description: Tracing programs by hand with a trace table across loops, calls, arrays and objects; choosing edge-case test inputs
